$description: Braun / Field, black anodized edition (added; the reference is aluminium only). The same instrument in matte-black anodizing: keycaps become graphite POM, the contrasting key turns aluminium, highlights fall to a faint sheen and the orange brightens a step so lit segments still read. Opt in with <html data-theme="dark"> or follow the OS with data-theme="auto".
